security_audit.summary: Most static command-execution and blocker findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, prose, CSS, and regex .exec() in a color parser. The confirmed risks are low-severity external network dependencies for p5.js and Google Fonts, which can load third-party resources and expose browser metadata.

remediation.suggestion: Bundle p5.js with the template or pin it with integrity metadata and document the network dependency.
Self-host the required font files or use local fallback fonts when offline or privacy-sensitive use matters.
Tell users when a generated HTML artifact will contact third-party CDNs and offer a fully local option.

content.value_statement: Generative art requests often need both creative direction and reproducible code. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create a philosophy, p5.js artifact, seed controls, and parameter exploration.
actual_capabilities: Creates a short algorithmic philosophy before implementation.
Uses p5.js patterns for seeded randomness and deterministic variation.
Builds a single HTML artifact with inline controls and canvas output.
Includes seed navigation, regeneration, reset, and PNG download controls.
Uses template files for viewer layout and code organization guidance.
limitations: Generated artifacts load p5.js and Google Fonts from external CDNs unless changed.
The skill provides guidance and templates; final art quality depends on implementation.
It targets browser-based p5.js work, not native applications or 3D engines.
It does not verify copyright safety beyond instructing original work.

use_cases.title: Prototype Generative Sketches
use_cases.description: Turn a theme or visual idea into a reproducible p5.js sketch with adjustable parameters.

use_cases.title: Build Interactive Artifacts
use_cases.description: Create a browser-ready artwork with seed controls, sliders, and download actions.

use_cases.title: Teach Creative Coding
use_cases.description: Show how concepts like particles, fields, and noise become visible through code.

prompt_templates.title: Start From A Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a complete artwork.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create algorithmic art inspired by tidal movement. Include the philosophy and a single interactive p5.js artifact.

prompt_templates.title: Control The Parameters
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with specific interaction needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a generative particle system with controls for density, turbulence, color, and speed. Use seeded randomness for repeatable results.

prompt_templates.title: Explore Variations
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for comparing seed outputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an interactive artwork and identify three strong seed values. Explain how each seed changes the composition.

prompt_templates.title: Develop A Custom System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with a defined computational concept.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a generative artwork based on recursive growth and field attraction. Include original parameters, performance notes, and polished controls.

output_examples.input: Create generative art about wind moving through tall grass.
output_examples.output: The result includes a concise movement philosophy and an interactive p5.js viewer with seed, wind strength, density, and color controls.

output_examples.input: Make a reproducible particle artwork with many variations.
output_examples.output: The result provides a deterministic seed system, next and previous seed controls, random seed generation, and a download action.

output_examples.input: Build a teaching example for noise fields.
output_examples.output: The result explains the algorithmic idea and presents a browser artifact where learners adjust scale, force, and trail length.

best_practices: Start with the algorithmic philosophy so the code has a clear visual direction.
Keep seed controls visible and test that the same seed returns the same result.
Choose parameters that change meaningful behavior, not only surface styling.
anti_patterns: Do not copy a known artist style or copyrighted artwork directly.
Do not replace the template with unrelated layout or unsupported libraries.
Do not add random sliders that have little visual effect.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates algorithmic art concepts and browser-ready p5.js artifacts with interactive controls.

faq.question: Does it require a server?
faq.answer: No. The intended output is a single HTML artifact that can run in a browser.

faq.question: Can users reproduce the same artwork?
faq.answer: Yes. The templates emphasize seeded randomness so the same seed returns the same visual result.

faq.question: Can it create animated art?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports static and animated p5.js sketches when the implementation includes animation logic.

faq.question: Does it use external resources?
faq.answer: Yes. The provided template loads p5.js and Google Fonts from external URLs unless the author changes it.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
